items.title: Parrot 7.0 Released with New Penetration Testing and AI Tools
items.description: Parrot OS 7.0, codenamed Echo, launches as a complete system rewrite based on Debian 13, bringing KDE Plasma 6, Wayland by default, and fresh penetration testing tools, including a dedicated AI category. items.title: Critical Langchain Vulnerability Let attackers Exfiltrate Sensitive Secrets from AI systems
items.description: A critical vulnerability in LangChain’s core library (CVE-2025-68664) allows attackers to exfiltrate sensitive environment variables and potentially execute code through deserialization flaws.
